_doc: L1 GLOBAL vessel constants. Source of truth for the financial atom. Every value carries provenance. Do NOT put localized opex here (captain wage, energy $/kWh, marina fee) — those live in L3 market locals.

pax_capacity.notes: 8 = base case. Note USCG Subchapter-T triggers >6 in US waters; SEA/intl markets generally allow 8.

capex_usd.source: Navier price (LYFT ref model, ex tax/fees)

annual_maintenance_usd.notes: Deep-dive warranted; may rise with high-utilization commercial duty.

depreciation_years.notes: 20yr straight-line = standard commercial marine convention for hull/vessel; conservative within the 20-25yr band. Halves annual depreciation vs prior 10yr placeholder.

diesel_comparable_nm_per_gal.notes: For carbon + cost-savings story vs diesel speedboat.

operating_defaults._doc: GLOBAL operating defaults (segment-driven). Overridable per market in L3.

_utilization_scenarios._doc: Headline = MID. Thin/Full are the sensitivity bookends we always show as a band (Jaideep 2026-06-06: report a band, not a single number). weather_uptime_factor stays per-market on top of these. Recalibrated 2026-06-21 (Jaideep): 15 tpd all scenarios; rev-leg thin .55, mid(HEADLINE) .65, full .75 — load factor is the primary sensitivity axis.

load_factor_default.source: MID scenario (headline). Recalibrated 2026-06-19: 0.55 avg occupancy on revenue sailings for premium on-demand. Thin=0.45 / Full=0.70 bookends.

monthly_operational_capacity.notes: Mechanical uptime (maintenance/charging/availability). Effective op days = 365 * this * weather_uptime_factor.

weather_uptime_factor._doc: Market-overridable seasonality/weather haircut layered ON TOP of mechanical uptime. 1.0 = year-round calm; <1.0 = monsoon/storm days that suppress service. Override per market in L3 as weather_uptime_factor.
weather_uptime_factor.source: Default no-haircut; set per market (e.g. Andaman monsoon ~0.85)

service_window_hr_per_day.source: Modeled single-asset commercial service window (one extended crew day, water-taxi norm). Conservative vs 24h.
service_window_hr_per_day.notes: Bounds trips/day to a believable duty cycle; not 22.5h.

discount_factor._doc: PRICE-PARITY (Jaideep locked 2026-06-06 PM): NO discount. Navier charges the market rate of the comparable transfer and wins on a better product (faster, quieter, zero-emission, on-demand), not on price. Factor = 1.0 across all segments. Prior segment-driven 0.5-0.7 retired.

ridehail.notes: Market parity — better product, not cheaper.

navier_capture_rate._doc: Navier wins ~10% of the corridor demand pool, never 100% (Jaideep locked 2026-06-06).

navier_capture_rate_by_archetype._doc: DORMANT until capture_override_enabled=true (Jaideep option A). Captive resort-transfer archetypes (airport->resort, no competing operator -> Navier IS the transfer fleet) capture ~90%. Contested ride-hail/ferry stay at global navier_capture_rate (10%). Raw archetype keys (pre-enrich rewrite). See MALDIVES-JIH-CAPTURE-DECISION.md.

commuter_modal_shift._doc: LB-97 modal-shift tier: capture rate (0.1-0.5% of LAND corridor volume) is ALREADY applied inside the staged demand pool (_demand_record documents floor/base/ceiling). Pool = post-capture addressable; applying global 10% again would double-discount. 1.0 = pass-through.

captive_capture_rate._doc: A-prime: per-corridor captive:true legs (sole-operator water-access-only transfers) capture ~90%. Inert until capture_override_enabled=true AND corridors tagged. See CAPTIVITY-CLASSIFICATION-DRAFT.md.

capture_on_addressable.note: LB-103: applied INSTEAD of navier_capture_rate when L3.pool_basis=='addressable' (pool already narrowed from gross to premium-addressable slice upstream; 10% on top = double discount). Ceiling 0.5 expressed via _demand_record addressable_pax_yr_ceiling = 2x base.

boarding_dwell_min.source: Premium board/deboard + scheduling slack added to each cycle (Jaideep 2026-06-19).

max_trips_per_day.source: Cap on revenue sailings/day — 15 across thin/mid/full scenarios (Jaideep 2026-06-21).

max_trips_per_day_by_archetype._doc: LB-256 (Jaideep 2026-06-19, scaled 2026-06-21): true high-frequency commuter / water-shuttle corridors sustain more revenue sailings/day than the premium on-demand default cap (15). Keyed on archetype; premium / tourism / ridehail / luxury stay at the default cap. A per-corridor L3 max_trips_per_day still wins over this.

premium_refare._doc: LB-255 (Jaideep 2026-06-19, decision B = re-fare at premium): a SUBSIDIZED public-transit fare is not the comparable a premium on-demand electric water-taxi prices against. Corridors whose comparable_fare_usd_pax is at/below subsidized_fare_ceiling are treated as subsidized benchmarks and re-faring lifts them to premium_ondemand_floor (the premium ride-hail / private water-taxi minimum seat fare). Genuine scheduled / premium fast-ferry fares ABOVE the ceiling (e.g. Aegean hydrofoils, Adriatic fast cats $7-24) are the correct premium comparable and are left untouched. Price-parity (discount_factor 1.0) still applies on the corrected comparable. A per-corridor L3 comparable_fare_usd_pax edit overrides this.

subsidized_fare_ceiling.source: Empirical break in the sourced fare distribution: genuine premium scheduled fast-ferry/hydrofoil per-seat fares bottom out ~$7-11; everything at/below ~$6 (Cairo $0.2, Abidjan $0.9-1.2, Lisbon commuter $1.6-3.4, Helsinki $3.6, Istanbul Eminönü-Üsküdar $2.5) is a subsidized public-transit floor.

premium_ondemand_floor.source: Premium ride-hail / private water-taxi minimum seat fare; conservative (below full Uber-Black-class pricing). Navier serves an otherwise-subsidized crossing only as a premium on-demand product, so it prices against the premium alternative, never the public ferry. L3-overridable.

country_operating_overrides._doc: Country-scoped operating corrections. These override schedule mechanics only for the exact country key; all other markets retain global defaults.

South Korea._doc: Approved 2026-07-11 audit correction: MID seat occupancy and revenue-leg utilization are separate 65% inputs; gross legs/day are schedule-derived with no fixed 15-leg ceiling.

mid_load_factor.unit: share of seats on revenue legs
mid_load_factor.source: South Korea economics revision approved 2026-07-11; retained audit scenario.

mid_revenue_leg_factor.unit: share of gross legs earning fare
mid_revenue_leg_factor.source: South Korea economics revision approved 2026-07-11; retained audit scenario.

boarding_dwell_min.source: Retained existing boarding/scheduling dwell; South Korea schedule audit, 2026-07-11.

charge_recovery.engineering_status: Planning proxy requiring engineering validation; not a certified charge curve.
charge_recovery.source: Retained South Korea audit proxy based on Navier published 70-nm range and 45-minute DC fast-charge figures.

crew_fte_factor.source: A captain can't run 7 days/wk; 1.8 FTE covers relief/leave/second-shift year-round (Jaideep 2026-06-19). Scales off localized captain wage.

insurance_pct_of_capex.source: Commercial vessel H&M + P&I ~2.5%/yr of regional CAPEX. Separate from berth/port admin in Country opex (Jaideep 2026-06-19).

charging_berth_annual_usd.source: Dedicated fast-charge berth slot + utility demand charges. Excludes per-kWh propulsion energy and berth/port admin (Jaideep 2026-06-19). L3-overridable per market.

diesel_kg_co2_per_gal.source: US EPA: 10.21 kg CO2 per gallon marine/diesel

grid_kg_co2_per_kwh_default.source: Global avg grid intensity placeholder; override per market grid in L3
